jsonld.name: Seller Net Sheet Calculator
jsonld.description: Estimate a home seller's net proceeds after real estate commission, mortgage payoff, transfer taxes, title fees and credits, plus the listing agent's take-home.

mainEntity.name: What is a seller net sheet?

acceptedAnswer.text: An estimate of the cash a seller receives at closing after the mortgage payoff, agent commissions, taxes, fees and credits are deducted from the sale price. Agents and title companies prepare one so sellers can compare offers by what they actually net.

mainEntity.name: Who pays the buyer's agent after the NAR settlement?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's negotiated. The seller can still agree to pay some or all of the buyer agent's fee, the buyer can pay it directly, or it can be requested as a concession in the offer. It just can't be advertised on the MLS.
Yes. There is no standard or legally set commission rate; both the listing fee and any buyer-agent compensation are negotiable.

mainEntity.name: Does this include capital gains tax?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Net proceeds here are before any tax on the gain. Many sellers of a main home can exclude up to $250,000 of gain ($500,000 married filing jointly) if they meet the ownership and use tests.
